card: A live dashboard app from one request
The GLP-1 race: trials and FDA reports, from free public data
A real run in the real interface. Waiting is time-lapsed; the clock shows real time.

depth.caption: 1 · Choose Deep in the effort menu

typing.caption: 2 · Ask for a dashboard on ClinicalTrials.gov and openFDA data

sent.caption: 3 · It tries both public APIs to see what they return

working.caption: 3 · It tries both public APIs to see what they return
4 · It writes the app's back end and runs it
5 · It saves the two APIs' own documentation, then writes the page and its charts
6 · It starts the app and looks at it: phone and desktop, light and dark
7 · A separate checker recomputes the figures and asks the sources directly
8 · It fixes what the checker found

finished.caption: 8 · Done after 26 min 2 s, with no approval asked

card.caption: 9 · The check: 38 items, 29 matched, 9 fixed, none left wrong

details.caption: 9 · Each finding says what was wrong and what was done; then its closing notes

scroll.caption: 10 · The app: 1,763 trials, filters, a map, a timeline, FDA reports, sources

end.caption: 10 · The app: 1,763 trials, filters, a map, a timeline, FDA reports, sources
